what_to_detect: A venture with no dungeon in the player's command zone puts one dungeon into it (dungeons entry added, marker on topmost room).
near_miss: A venture with a dungeon already in the command zone adds none; the marker moves along an arrow.
record_fields: state.command dungeons {player, dungeon, room} before and after (gen-3)
zone_change of the dungeon card into the command zone from VentureEffect's moveToCommand, if the collector writes one (unverified)

what_to_detect: A static whose condition is that its controller has completed a dungeon contributes to the board once that player's dungeons-completed count is 1 or more, a dungeon of theirs having been removed from the game.
near_miss: The same kind of static while its controller has completed no dungeon (count 0) contributes nothing.
record_fields: player dungeons-completed count (gen-3 in.history player scalars)
